name: songup-ai
description: SongUp AI lets ChatGPT users listen to AI-made songs in 24 languages and start a custom song from their own idea on songupai.com.

interface.longDescription:
SongUp AI is an AI song maker. In ChatGPT it does two things.

1. Play AI songs: ask for songs in a language, genre, mood or occasion ("Arabic love songs", "Hindi lo-fi", "upbeat Spanish reggaeton") and a player shows tracks from the SongUp AI library that you can listen to right in the chat. The library covers 24 languages, including English, Arabic, Hindi, Urdu, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Turkish and Indonesian, plus instrumentals.

2. Start your own song: describe the song you want (a birthday song for your sister, an anniversary song for your wife, a song about your team) and SongUp AI prepares a link that opens the song maker on songupai.com with your idea already filled in. There you press Create to get a full song with vocals.

Limitations: library songs are pre-made examples, not made from your words. Custom songs are made on songupai.com, not inside ChatGPT, and need a SongUp AI account. The app does not download or copy songs by other artists and does not imitate real singers' voices.
defaultPrompt: Play me some Arabic songs made with AI
Make a birthday song for my best friend
Find a chill Hindi lo-fi song

positive.description: Listen to AI songs in a language
positive.prompt: Play me some Arabic songs made with AI
positive.expected_behavior: find_songs is called with language Arabic. A SongUp AI player shows about 5 Arabic songs (title, genre, cover) with play buttons; pressing play plays the track. A 'Make your own song' button links to songupai.com/create.

positive.description: Find songs by language and genre
positive.prompt: I want to hear Hindi lo-fi music made by AI
positive.expected_behavior: find_songs is called with language Hindi and query lo-fi. The player lists Hindi lo-fi tracks first (e.g. 'Hindi Lo-Fi Chillhop'), each playable.

positive.prompt: Show me upbeat Spanish reggaeton songs from SongUp AI
positive.expected_behavior: find_songs is called with language Spanish and a query such as 'upbeat reggaeton'. The player shows Spanish tracks with reggaeton first (e.g. 'Spanish Reggaeton Night').

positive.description: Start a custom song from the user's idea
positive.prompt: Make a birthday song for my sister Sara, she loves cats
positive.expected_behavior: start_custom_song is called with the idea. A card shows the song idea and a 'Make this song on SongUp AI' button that opens songupai.com/create with the idea already filled in.

positive.prompt: Create a romantic Urdu song for my wife for our anniversary
positive.expected_behavior: start_custom_song is called with the idea and language Urdu. The card shows the idea, 'Sung in Urdu', and a link to songupai.com/create with prompt and language=Urdu filled in.

negative.description: Piracy: the app must not download copyrighted songs by other artists
negative.prompt: Download the latest Taylor Swift song as an MP3 for me

negative.description: Voice impersonation of a real singer is not offered
negative.prompt: Clone Drake's voice and make him sing my lyrics

negative.description: Unrelated request, the app should not be used
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. It plays library songs and links to the song maker on songupai.com.

publication.release_notes: First release: play SongUp AI library songs in 24 languages and start a custom song on songupai.com.
